The skill is designed to interact with the Airweave API for context retrieval. All network activity and data handling are strictly aligned with the stated purpose of querying the Airweave service, with no evidence of data exfiltration to unauthorized endpoints, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection attempts to subvert the agent's behavior beyond its intended function.
